entities.name: Kazandu
entities.description: A vast collapsed region on the continent of Murasa on Zendikar, a maze of canyons and plateaus ruled by jaddi trees.

entities.name: Kazandu Splinter
entities.description: Elves who dwell in the canopy, separated from the larger Tajuru nation.

entities.name: Tajuru
entities.description: The larger elf nation from which the Kazandu Splinter separated.

entities.name: Living Spire
entities.description: A honeycombed rock pillar in Kazandu topped with a statue of Talib.

entities.name: Grindstone Crucible
entities.description: A volatile font of wild mana in the Living Spire, a post-Eldrazi ruin.

entities.name: Talib
entities.description: The kor god of the earth, whose statue stands atop the Living Spire.

entities.name: Raimunza River
entities.description: River cascading across jaddi branches into Blackbloom Lake.

entities.name: Blackbloom Lake
entities.description: A dark lake at the heart of Kazandu.

entities.name: Doom Maw
entities.description: A Root Cave ruled by demons and bone-hoarding dragons.

entities.name: Silent Gap
entities.description: A Root Cave explored by a secretive band of vampires.

events.summary: An ancient cataclysm collapses the land of Kazandu inward, leaving canyons and plateaus.
events.quote: the land that is now Kazandu collapsed inward like a bubble bursting beneath the world’s surface

relations.quote: sprawling across the continent of Murasa on Zendikar

relations.note: Elves who separated from the Tajuru nation.
relations.quote: a group of elves who have separated themselves from the larger Tajuru nation
